arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One clean 2D cartoon water effect sprite. A very SMALL LOW splash/ripple shaped as shallow upward-curving white/cyan swoosh, with short spray spikes clustered over LEFT end and a thin rising RIGHT tip. Match original silhouette and detached tiny flecks. Convert source dark diagnostic blue to pale cyan highlights/white foam, never dark blue/navy puddle. Do not add a full wave or tall splash. First source ONLY geometry authority, redraw pixel steps into smooth flowing curves. Second image ONLY water materials: bright white foam with restrained PALE CYAN/light-blue undersides. Ignore its particular wave outline and any RGB glow in transparent pixels. No black/navy/dark gray fill or shadow puddle; no outside glow/haze. Actual alpha transparency between droplets and ring holes, transparent background, no ocean plane/scenery/text/ground shadow. Keep complete source-shaped effect inside canvas with5% clear margin.
